set -uo pipefail
save=()
if [[ -n $7 ]]; then save=(--save "$7"); fi
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$1" "$2" "$3" - --raw --cadical "$4" "${save[@]}" \
  2> "$6/producer.err" |
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$5" "$2" - > "$6/kernel.out" 2> "$6/kernel.err"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
printf '%s %s\n' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}" > "$6/exit-status.txt"
if (( statuses[0] != 0 || statuses[1] != 0 )); then exit 1; fi
grep -Fxq 'challenge proven' "$6/kernel.out"
! grep -Fxq 'Inconsistency proven!' "$6/kernel.out"

selection.selection: recorded native UNSAT<=1s; stratified4..32/32..128/128..512KiB; smallest first within tiers; max cases/family; conservative single-query/no-positive-arity screen

limitations: Pilot only: 24 inputs per logic, historical native UNSAT <=1s; unchanged source hashes. No general corpus coverage or solver performance claim.
Both historical and present native runs use default preprocessing; this pilot has no preprocess-off retries. All selected historical args are --quiet.
Only 1 verified arithmetic-bearing proof per logic; remaining 2 verified per logic are Boolean refutations with zero theory conflicts.
Original-source statement translation remains trusted. The checker rebuilds its own CNF; Primo preprocessing is not proved.
LIA checker gets an explicit one-byte version-2 envelope copy. Native version-3 artifact is kept.
Source_refutation_missing means supplied conflicts cannot refute the checker abstraction, not that the original source is SAT. Exact cause is unproven.
No proof timeout, file cap, kill or workflow error was observed. One Z3 reference timeout was not exported.
Unsuccessful challenges and certificates/logs remain in the result tree; successful challenge dumps were hashed then removed; raw proof was never stored.
Family cap leaves LRA tiers at 14/9/1 instead of target 8/8/8; no claim to balanced LRA size coverage.
No C++ changes, so native full suite, ASan, fuzz, tidy and include-cleaner were not repeated; workflow unit tests, lint, docs and SLURM pilot are fresh.
